_comment: Multi-page + per-page config. Keys under "pages" are Facebook Pages. Do NOT put pageId/tokens here — use secrets FB_PAGE_IDS and FB_PAGE_TOKENS. pages.dds = Digong image posts; pages.duterte = Digong/DDS text engagement; pages.bbm = BBM text; pages.sarah = Sarah Duterte text. Config keys: postType (image|text), imageProvider, imageModel, imageSize, published, link, slots.
